services.heading: Mining & Geological Consulting Services
services.subheading: PT Lugas Inti Semesta provides specialist technical services to assist companies in exploration, development, operations, as well as environmental management and post-mining. Each service is tailored to the project's conditions, commodities, technical requirements, available data, and client targets.
services.scope_desc: Below are the specific services and technical activities we provide in this field:
services.cta_heading: Find the Right Solution for Your Project
services.cta_subheading: Share your project requirements, location, commodity type, and work targets with our team to get the appropriate service scope recommendations.
services.page_hero_desc: PT Lugas Inti Semesta provides technical consulting services for the mineral and coal industry, covering geology & exploration, geotechnics, hydrology & hydrogeology, mining consulting, and environmental & social. Each service is tailored to project conditions, technical requirements, and operational objectives.
services.page_hero_tagline: From field investigations to technical study preparation and recommendations.
services.page_cta_desc: Share your project location, commodity, technical requirements, or scope of work with the PT Lugas Inti Semesta team to get appropriate service guidance.
services.trust_subheading: Field experience, business legality, and multidisciplinary competence are the foundation of PT Lugas Inti Semesta in providing technical services for the mining industry.
services.trust_1_desc: Experienced in supporting various mineral and coal mining activities across various regions of Indonesia.
services.trust_2_desc: Holds Mining Services Business License No. 738/1/IUJP/PMDN/2021 as the legal basis for mining service delivery.
services.trust_3_desc: Supported by Competent Person Indonesia (CPI) experts, geologists, mining engineers, and related technical fields.
services.approach_p1: Every mining project has different geological conditions, technical requirements, operational targets, and challenges. PT Lugas Inti Semesta begins every project by understanding client needs, evaluating initial data, and determining the scope of work appropriate to the project's conditions.
services.approach_p2: In exploration and geology activities, this approach may include mapping, drilling, field supervision, data collection, resource interpretation and evaluation. For geotechnical and hydrogeological needs, investigations are conducted to obtain technical parameters supporting project planning and risk management.
services.approach_p3: PT Lugas Inti Semesta also supports companies in mining consulting needs such as feasibility studies, RKAB, E-RKAB, mine management, and environmental & social needs including AMDAL, reclamation, post-mining, and community development. Work results are prepared to provide data, studies, and technical recommendations that can be used as a basis for company decision-making.

about.heading: Your Trusted Mining Solution Partner
about.description: Since 2014, PT Lugas Inti Semesta has been dedicated to providing geological, geotechnical, and coal & mineral mine management consulting services.
about.description2: Supported by certified Competent Person Indonesia (CPI) experts and official IUJP license No. 738/1/IUJP/PMDN/2021, we deliver optimal solutions.
about.background_text: PT Lugas Inti Semesta was established to provide services in geology, exploration, mine management assistance, mining contractor services, geotechnics, hydrology and hydrogeology, as well as environmental and social expertise including social mapping, document preparation, and public consultation support.
about.vision_text: To be a trusted partner, providing appropriate and effective solutions in the mining industry.
about.mission_text: To provide the best professional services to mining companies in various operational aspects.
about.legality_class: Technical and Management Consulting Classification for Coal and Mineral Mining Industry
about.legality_cpi: Supported by certified Competent Person Indonesia (CPI) experts
about.team_placeholder: Expert team data will be displayed soon.
about.meta_desc: Since 2014, PT Lugas Inti Semesta has been dedicated to providing geological, geotechnical, and coal & mineral mine management consulting services.
about.intro_p1: PT Lugas Inti Semesta is a mining consulting company that provides technical and management services for the mineral and coal industry.
about.intro_p2: Established in 2014 in Bekasi, West Java, our company holds a Mining Services Business License Number 738/1/IUJP/PMDN/2021 and is supported by Competent Person Indonesia experts, geologists, and experienced mining professionals in various project stages.
about.intro_p3: We help mining companies obtain data, studies, and technical recommendations that can be used as a basis for planning, decision-making, fulfilling operational needs, and preparing mining documents.
about.pengalaman_p1: The scope of services of PT Lugas Inti Semesta includes geological and exploration consulting, geotechnics, hydrology, hydrogeology, mining consulting, as well as environmental and social consulting.
about.pengalaman_p2: These experiences include geological mapping, UAV topographic mapping, exploration and geotechnical drilling, geophysical logging, wellsite geology, slug test and pumping test, resource and reserve estimation, RKAB preparation, feasibility studies, mine management, to the preparation of environmental and social documents.
about.pengalaman_p3: We have been involved in coal and various mineral commodity projects in several regions of Indonesia, including Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Nusa Tenggara, and other areas.
about.legalitas_intro: As an IUJP-licensed mining services company, PT Lugas Inti Semesta carries out its work prioritizing:
legalitas_items: Accuracy and integrity of technical data.
Compliance with the scope of work.
about.legalitas_outro: Every project is handled through coordination between experts, field teams, and client representatives so that the work results match actual conditions and project needs.
about.cta_subheading: Discuss your project condition, scope of work, and targeted goals with the PT Lugas Inti Semesta team.
